Mnesia is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2025 to 2026.

What it was for: [AI engineering](@/projects/ai.md) (2).

Most recently: [sig](@/work/sig.md): distributed cognitive framework in Elixir/OTP; [edna](@/work/edna.md): Edna je digitální kartářka, astroložka a analytička poháněná AI. Projekt spojuje mystiku, astrologii a psychologii s moderními LLM modely, aby uživatelům přinášel denní horoskopy, výklady karet, životní vhledy a psychologické reflexe.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Mnesia: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Mnesia to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
